findings.title: [P3] Add regression coverage for lock release on success and failure
findings.body: Nothing in the repository verifies the behavior this PR introduces — that `release()` runs after `work()` both fulfills and rejects. Without a regression test, the original leak (simply `return work();`) could be reintroduced undetected. The repo currently has no tests or test infrastructure at all, which is why this is a minor gap rather than a blocking one; adding even a minimal harness-level test for the success and rejection paths would lock in the fix.
